Introduction

Park Boram was a South Korean singer-songwriter under Xanadu Entertainment. She first appeared in the talent show "Superstar K" in 2010 where she finished eighth place. From then she started training until she made her official debut in 2014 with the digital single "Beautiful."

On April 12, 2024, Xanadu Entertainment confirmed reports that Park Boram tragically passed away on the night of April 11th. Her cause of death was later revealed to be acute alcohol poisoning.
